title: activitypub/outbound.rs: body.to_vec() clones entire payload per follower
description:
Why this issue exists: deliver_one clones the entire serialized JSON body for each follower in the fanout loop. For many followers this is O(n) clones.

What needs to be done: Build the body bytes once before the fanout loop and pass Bytes (cheap Arc clone) to each delivery call.
